Latin word

factum

factum, factī n.

noun, second declension

deed, act, what someone has done; a deed, an act

    the recommended word · classical · Caesar in Cic. Att. 9.16.2: meum factum probārī abs tē; Hor. Ep. 1.2.40: dīmidium factī

    classical

  • Ō factum male!: too bad!

    classical
